Mission Statement
“The mission of the Ray County Coroner’s Office is to conduct thorough, professional, and impartial investigations into all deaths within the county, ensuring the accurate determination of cause and manner of death. We are dedicated to serving the community with respect, sensitivity, and transparency, providing families with the support they need during difficult times. Through ethical practices, collaboration with law enforcement, and adherence to the highest standards of forensic science, we aim to promote justice, safety, and public health in our county.”
Vision Statement
“Our vision is to provide compassionate, professional, and timely services in the investigation of deaths, ensuring transparency, respect, and support for the families and communities we serve. We are committed to upholding the highest standards of integrity, accuracy, and care, while fostering a safe and informed environment through diligent work, expert knowledge, and effective communication. Our goal is to offer peace of mind through thorough, ethical investigations that contribute to the well-being and justice of Ray County.”
